content: Abided cuidadec unëste abentsëquënquiobi

Setan-setanquien nidaidën capuquid yua cuesuneshun intac bedshun buanec puduedsho isun matses icsaid bedshunash abided unësash abi tantiaquido chuinuec bëyucanec Nuquin Papa yacnoësh yuedanquidquio choec, quequin nuquin tsusedpabon tantiabempampic. Nidaidën capuquid yua cuesuneshun intac buanquid aton matses icsaisa icmetiapimbo yec Nuquin Papa yacnombo abëd onquetiapimbo icpanëdash.
Aidënquio daseccaquin matses icsaisa icmiac nidaidën capuquid yua padpiden cuesunenquio ictsempampic. Adecbidi, Icsambocquid nebi, quenquio matses ictsiandac.
Aton matses isaisa icmetiapimbocquin setan-setanquien nidaidën capuquid yuaded cuesunepanëdash.
Adshun yuan intac bedshun daseccaidën matses icsaisa icmetiapimbo iquec.
Adoaquien Esuquidistu nidaidënshun tishac caniash onquec:

content.text: “Nidaidën capuquid yua cuesunenubi ëmbi chiacpadomboen matsesën natiapimbo iquec queshun yua cuesunete bunenquio mibi iquec, Papa.
Matsesën tishtequid mimbi icmiaidquio nebi, Papa.
Adecbidi nidaidën capuquid abichobi tauideniac matses abi icsambo iquec, quiash, Padi. Adoenda, mibi quec, Papa.
Adsho isun mimbi chuiquin dada uamiampicpadomboen naimbi, Papa.”

content: Mimbi dada uamiampicpadomboen matses chuiquidën nabanquimbi aton matsesbëd bëdamboec tabadenquiocsho isash, Padi. Aid nainquiocquin ënta, quequin mimbi matses chuinuc
mimbi ënden nadomboen nata cain chiaid naimbi, Papa, quiash matses icsaid bedshunash abided cuidadec unësun Nuquin Papan ënden chiaid ëmepanëdash. Aden ëmian nëbi Nuquin Papan chiaid utsi iquec.
Aden Nuquin Papa bunacpadomboen nash unëstiapimbo yanshun abi unëste ushënquio abi tantiaquid paucpanëdash.
Aden matses icsaid paucpec, quetiapimbocnoc badiadquiën-badiadquidënquien nidaidën capuquid yua cuesuneshun intac bedshun daseccaquin icbo icsaidbëdta utsibo icsaid pauctiapimbo iquendac.
Esuquidistuen abided unësash abi tantiaquido icsaid pauctequid abentsëquiobi iquec aton Papabëdi ënëdtiapimbo yec abitedishun icbombo iquec.
Ambobi tabadquimbi abi chieshënquido ambi chiacpadomboen naquidquio icmete ushë cainec.
Abided unëste ushënquio abi tantiaquid ambi icsaisa icmiaid abëd cuëshëdesambo yampanëdash.
Adembidi Nuquin Papan Mayanën Nuquin Papan chiaid utsi naden chiec:

content.text: “Nëbi ëbëd tabadmenun chiaid utsi nendac, quequin chiendambi.
Adembidi ëmbi chiacpadomboen nate bunquidquio icmendambi, quec Icbo.”

content: Adshumbic Nuquin Papan chiaid utsi abi chiec aton Mayan:

content.text: “Abi icsaidtedi padpiden tantianu quenquio yec bëpiscudendabi, queoaic Icbo,”

content: quequin chuipanëdash aton Mayanën.
Adec abi icsaid bëpiscudash nidaidën capuquid yua cuesuneta quenquio Nuquin Papa iquec.
Nuquin Papa yacno puduedte cainta
Adoaidi Esuquidistu unësacsho isun cudan siac aton intac chiuidan, Ambi paucaid nebi, quec dacuëdenquio yec Nuquin Papan shubu icsaisa caid yacnombo puduedte ushë nuqui cainendac.
Matsesash abided cuidadec unësash Nuquin Papa yacno puduedoash tabadquid Esuquidistu nec.
Ambo nidash Nuquin Papabëd onquequin aton shubun icquido nuqui Esuquidistun chuibanubi,
Ambi paucaid ambi dapanacbimboecquidbidi nebi, quequin tantiaquin abi yacno choacbimboen nidaidënshun Nuquin Papa chiec onquec tabadnuna.
Nuquin Papa ambi chiacpadomboen naquidquio nec, quequin abi tantiaquid yec abi yacno puduedebi, quequin caimbudnuna.
Aden tantiaquin abi tantiaquid utsibobëd tantiananec bëdamboec tabadquin nashununa.

Aden nabanec abi tantiaquid utsibobëd iccuededtiapimbo iquebi, utsi-utsiec quiacpadec adenquio icnuna. Adec iccuededec, Nuquin Papan chiacpadquiec bëdamboec tabadnuna, quec chuinanta. Niacquid dadpen icsho isash, Matsesën naid chuibanquin cuidte ushë badedquio choec, quiash baded-badedquiec chuinanta bëdamboec tabadte bunec.
Ëbi icsaid bedshunash abided cuidadec Esuquidistu unëspanëdash, quequin tantiash icsaded-icsadedquid iquec, Adquidquio Esus nec, quetiapimbo iquec.
Aid cuidte ushë chonoc nëishun comapenen chushcaindac Nuquin Papan abi chieshënquido nibëdamequin.
Nadomboen nata cain Moisesën chiaid niacsho isun daëdshun chiac niacquid unësmiampic.

Nuquin Papan abia naden nata cain chiaid niactenequid adomboen cuidnushe quiash ëbi icsaid bedshunash abided cuidadec Esuquidistu unëspanëdash, queboedi, Ëmbi tantiaboed Nuquin Papan Madopenquio matsesquio ëbipadquid icsacsho cuesuniac, quequin chieshënsho ¿comapenen Nuquin Papan cuidenquioda icpadic? Adquid Nuquin Papan Mayanën bëdambocquid icmenu quequin chiaid chieshënquid nec.
Nuquin Papan: “Ëmbimbo ëmbi chiaid chieshënquid cuidendambi,” quequin chiaid nec, quequin nuqui tantiec. Adembidi: “Abi tantiaquid icboedëmbi tantienquio yansho cuidquidquio Nuquin Icbo iquendac.
Abi cuidantequid dacuëdampambo iquec,” quequin Nuquin Papan chiaid nec.

Esuquidistu tantiaquid yanash mibi bëdamboec tabadondacpaden tantiamec chuinandeneta. Esuquidistu tantiabenacchuca icsho chieshëmënquidon mëyanaqui, Esuquidistu tantiaquid nebi, quec dayacquio yec bëdamboec mibi tabadteniondac.

Dadpen tabadnubi, ëmbi tantiaid Esus nec, quesho mibi utsibon mamënshunondash. Adembidi aidon natiambocquin mëyanac. Adomboembidi Esuquidistu tantiaquid utsi mëyansho isun, Aidbëd icquid nebi, quequin ismequin mimbi nashundenepondac.

Esuquidistu tantiaquid utsi quënën nauedaid icsho isash abëdi tabadacbimboec natiamianquiec unësquio yec mibi tabadpondac. Adecbidi mibi chieshënquidën mitsana bedacsho isash Nuquin Papan ëbi menetequid ampetiapimbo iquec, quequin tantiec, Bëdambo iquebi, quec mibi tabadpondac.
Adoaidi Nuquin Papan bacuë yec bëdambo iquebi, quiash dacuëdenquio yec bëdamboen nabanec mibi ënden dayacquio iccondacpadquiec adquiecbidi tabadteneta. Adquid Nuquin Papa yacno puduedquid nendac.
Utsin mëyanaqui Nuquin Papan chiaid chieshenquiocquin tantiadeneta. Adec tabadquin Nuquin Papa bunacpadomboen nabanash abi yacno tabadendac.
Nuquin Papan chiaid nadquio iquec:

content.text: “Chiata. Nëbien mimbi cainaid mibi mënchictequid choendac.
Adsho tantiec ambi pauctequid abi cainec tabadec nec.

content: quec Nuquin Papa.

Aid cainuidash utsi tabadnubi abi choate nuqui cainec. Abi cainesa abi yacno puduedmenquiocquin Nuquin Papan chian anëdënquequid nësiatequid nendac. Nuquien abi cainquid yec Nuquin Papa yacno puduedtequid nec.
